name: 矿晶虫
evolution: 矿晶虫 → 晶石蜗 Lv.40 → 钻石蜗
description: 喜欢攀附于潮湿的岩层，以土壤中的矿粒为食，常被用作衡量矿产资源丰富度的标志。身上的晶体可以将细小的光线通过折射放大数倍，四只矿晶虫便能照亮一整个矿洞，是备受矿工喜爱的精灵。
descriptionEn: It likes to cling to damp rock layers and feeds on the mineral grains in the soil, and is often used as a marker for how rich a mineral deposit is. The crystals on its body can refract and amplify faint light several times over; four of them can light up an entire mine tunnel, making it a spirit much loved by miners.
